name: Fey’ri
sourceDistinctions: Races of Faerûn gives the original player traits, including at-will indefinite humanoid alter self and a 40-ft. poor fly speed in winged form.
The 2004 Monster Update converts the earlier Monsters of Faerûn entry. This 3.5 adaptation applies its Change Shape and DR 10/magic to the player chassis and retains the 2003 four-choice list.
A character can select only one of DR, dimension door, and enervation. That choice raises LA from +2 to +3. Selected spell-like abilities use character level, not effective character level.
The 2004 guide describes an optional lesser planetouched framework but gives no named Lesser Fey’ri entry. The builds use the Native Outsider form.
portraitForm: Vaelis Ashthread, an original Fey’ri in her natural winged form
